# MechWarrior 5: Clans

| genre = Vehicle simulation
| modes = Single-player, multiplayer

MechWarrior 5: Clans is a vehicle simulation video game, developed by Piranha Games and released worldwide on October 16, 2024. It is a standalone expansion of MechWarrior 5: Mercenaries, based on the BattleTech/MechWarrior game universe.
Synopsis
MechWarrior 5: Clans is set in the BattleTech universe. The player plays the role of starcommander of a Clan Smoke Jaguar star, during the start of the Clan invasion.
Reception
| PCGUS = 82/100
| IGN = 80/100
}}
As of November 2024, MechWarrior 5: Clans had "Generally Favorable" reviews according to review aggregator Metacritic.
